en: Clare is Jon's older sister.
notes: RESOLVED: అక్క ("elder sister") and చెల్లి ("younger sister") both confirmed in data/master_words.tsv as distinct established terms — Telugu genuinely has no age-neutral "sister," and అక్క is specifically correct since Clare is stated as Jon's OLDER sister. Direct precedent, not a guess.

en: She always makes him do his homework.
notes: RESOLVED: చేయిస్తుంది (causative) kept. The Telugu causative is the standard, unmarked way to express "make/have someone do something" and carries no more force than English "makes him do his homework" already does — a sibling ensuring homework gets done, not coercion. The English itself says "makes," so matching that force is correct, not an overstatement.
